purpose: Checks a monthly PPSI reserve disclosure against two statute-derived GENIUS Act S.394 §4 requirements: 1:1 reserve coverage arithmetic and attestation presence/timeliness against the statutory monthly cadence. Verdict per requirement (MET/NOT_MET/INDETERMINATE). NARROWED 2026-08-07, updated 2026-10-29: the permitted-asset composition check is out of scope in this row. The OCC issued its final implementing rule on 2026-10-21 (Bulletin 2026-50, 12 CFR Part 15, effective 2027-01-18); final rules of the other primary Federal payment stablecoin regulators were not checked. Never claims final-rule attribution or compliance certification. Cross-links the shipped pre-issuance precheck_reserve_attestation (art-06) and the fuller check_genius_reserve_disclosure (art-275).
